Class Tessel

java.lang.Object
net.tessel.fx.Tessel
public final class Tessel extends Object
Entry point of Tessel for JavaFX: installs the theme, switches between light, dark and system themes at runtime, and offers a few styling helpers. 
public void start(Stage stage) {
    Tessel.setup(TesselTheme.SYSTEM);          // or LIGHT / DARK; call it before the first window is shown
    stage.setScene(new Scene(root));
    stage.show();
}
Once installed, every scene of every window (including pop-ups, context menus and dialogs) is themed automatically, and follows setTheme(TesselTheme) and setAccent(Color). Call apply(Scene) to theme a scene explicitly, or put IGNORE in its properties to leave it alone.

Methods that change the theme must be called on the JavaFX application thread (they are forwarded there when called from another thread).
